svg.text: The tool registry: 20 tools in 11 categories (foehn commands, Foehncraft 0.6.0)

rect.title: system.info: Version, commit, platform, threads, features and backends of this build.
system.backends: The kernel backends compiled into this build.
system.commands: The catalogue of every tool with its input and output schemas.
case.schema: The JSON Schema of the flow case file (D77) in its format envelope.
case.check: Check a flow case: validation, boundary conditions on the first mesh and the cost estimate (D78, D81).
case.resolve: Read a flow case the way a run does and return it with the defaults filled in and the overrides applied, as TOML.
case.estimate: What a run of a flow case will cost before it starts (D81): cells, steps, memory, output volume, wall time.
case.upgrade: Bring case files of an older case format to the current one (renamed keys, `case_format`), keeping their comments; writes them with `write`.
diag.codes: The diagnostic codes (D78) with their usual severity and meaning.
materials.list: Every material of the database with its properties at a temperature and a pressure.
materials.show: One material with its property forms, values, data range and sources.
expression.eval: Compile an expression (D53) with constants and tables and evaluate it at points.
mesh.process: Build or read a mesh, check it, partition it and write the quality report and a VTKHDF file.
flow.run: Run a flow case (steady, transient, sweeps) and return the result summary of `result.json`; streams the rows of the run record and stops on request.
result.read: The result summary (`result.json`, `foehncraft.result`) of an earlier run.
post.derive: Write the fields with derived fields (vorticity, Q, lambda2, wall shear stress, y+ ...) from a restart file of a case (D72).
study.scalar: Solve a steady scalar convection-diffusion case (stage 2): one mesh, an order-of-accuracy sweep or solver variants, on the CPU and the GPU.
study.poisson: Study the pressure solver on a Poisson problem (stage 3): CG with multigrid, Jacobi and hypre over refinement levels, on the CPU and the GPU.
study.g1: Gate G1: the kernel benchmark, the single-source route against hand-written references (docs/benchmarks/g1.md).
journal.replay: Replay the tool calls of a journal or a run record in order, without a window, and report each call that ends differently from its record (D197).
